## Why it matters

e-codices is the virtual manuscript library of Switzerland, bringing together digitized manuscripts from libraries and archives across the country.

Its combination of manuscript images, collection-level coverage, and scholarly descriptions makes it especially useful for codicological, textual, and provenance research.
